abstract: Maintains secondary fueling network access and regional supply base staging records
system_message:
You are Aviation logistics coordinator (LOG). The aviation logistics coordinator (LOG) maintains records regarding secondary fueling network access, regional supply base staging distances, and avionics spare rotation inventories across emergency flight operators.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Avionics spare rotation（PART）
information_points.content:
LOG-PART-PI9：The logistics depot inventory ledger records 4 units of line-replaceable flight computer reserves in central inventory for Glacier Peak Rotorcraft Services.
LOG-PART-REZ：Northern Alpine Air Ambulance holds 6 units of line-replaceable flight computer reserves in ready-to-install navigation processor inventory.
LOG-PART-2UW：Columbia Valley Search and Flight holds 2 units of line-replaceable flight computer reserves ready for installation in its central high-altitude avionics spares inventory.

information_points.title: Maintains secondary fueling network access and regional supply base staging records（STAG）
information_points.content:
LOG-STAG-ZEA：Within the designated mountain emergency flight corridor, Columbia Valley Search and Flight registers a dedicated mountain refueling base distance of 45 km to its primary fuel depot.
LOG-STAG-MHP：According to the regional fueling survey across designated mountain emergency flight corridors, Glacier Peak Rotorcraft Services has a dedicated mountain refueling base distance of 110 km to its primary fuel depot.
LOG-STAG-IMB：Survey records for the designated mountain emergency flight corridor show that Northern Alpine Air Ambulance maintains a dedicated mountain refueling base distance of 75 km.
